statement: A positive integer is \textit{guarani} if the sum of the number and its reversal has only odd digits. (a) How many 2021-digit numbers are guarani? (b) How many 2023-digit numbers are guarani?

In $\triangle ABC$ with incenter $I$, lines $BI$ and $CI$ meet the circumcircle again at $M$ and $N$. Circles $C_1$ (diameter $NI$) and $C_2$ (diameter $MI$) meet $AB$ at $P, Q$ and $AC$ at $R, S$. Show $P, Q, R, S$ are concyclic.

Each member of a tennis club has exactly $k > 0$ friends. A tournament is played in rounds: each round, pairs of friends play simultaneously until no more can be added. Find the maximum number of rounds, depending on $k$.
A heap of 2021 stones. $A$ may remove 1, 2, or 7 stones; $B$ may remove 1, 3, 4, or 6 stones. The player emptying the pile wins. Who has a winning strategy?
For $n \geq 3$, do there exist $n$ distinct integers $b_1, \ldots, b_n$ and an integer-coefficient polynomial $P$ with $P(b_1)=b_2, P(b_2)=b_3, \ldots, P(b_n)=b_1$?

Scalene $\triangle ABC$ with circumcircle $\Gamma$; $P, Q, R, S$ distinct points on $BC$ (in order) with $\angle BAP = \angle CAS$ and $\angle BAQ = \angle CAR$. Let $U, V, W, Z$ be second intersections of $AP, AQ, AR, AS$ with $\Gamma$. Let $X = UQ \cap SW$, $Y = PV \cap ZR$, $T = UR \cap VS$, $K = PW \cap ZQ$, $M = KX \cap TY$, $N = TX \cap KY$. Show $M, N, A$ are collinear.
